exposure: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
outcome: Trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) success rate
cohort: 437 women who underwent a trial of labor after one cesarean section
finding: The success rate of TOLAC was 56.3%, and factors associated with success included maternal age ≥ 35 years, fetal station at admission ≤ zero, previous vaginal delivery, and successful VBAC.
